scientific_question: Conditional on the frozen pointwise support score and simple geographic distance to the nearest training presence, does occurrence-anchored island-chain structure contain additional held-out incidence information?
not_a_question: Is EOG universally better than SDMs?
What is the probability that the species dispersed along this path?
Which historical colonisation route actually occurred?
Are graph edges demographic or genetic connections?

graph_nodes.nodes: all 842 species-linked surveyed islands with frozen centroids and primary climate predictors
graph_nodes.interpretation: All islands represent potential structural stepping-stone locations. Their inclusion does not assert that they were occupied or used as an actual dispersal route.

anchors.anchor_definition: training-fold presence islands for the focal species
anchors.no_anchor_policy: species-fold reachability is not evaluable; do not change the fold or borrow held-out labels

environmental_geometry.source: same frozen CHELSA-bioclim 2.1 direct-centroid predictors used by the support-model contract
environmental_geometry.scaling: fit median/MAD robust reference on training islands only within each fold, using climate values but no species labels
environmental_geometry.edge_environmental_distance: Euclidean distance in the training-fitted robust climate reference

geographic_radius_provenance.rule: rounded pre-outcome scales from the 842-island nearest-neighbour geometry, spanning approximately q90, q97.5, q99 and the maximum nearest-neighbour separation

scenario_ensemble.environmental_threshold_derivation: For each fold and geographic radius, derive q90 or q75 from environmental distances of training-training island pairs whose geographic distance is within that radius. Apply that frozen fold/radius threshold to all graph edges. No species labels enter threshold derivation.
scenario_ensemble.edge_rule: undirected edge exists when geographic distance is <= the scenario radius and, when an environmental filter is active, robust climate distance is <= the training-derived environmental threshold
scenario_ensemble.barrier_cost: none in the primary A-Islands contract because the exact frozen source does not provide a validated species-independent barrier attribute; the geographic edge limit itself is an explicit structural assumption
scenario_ensemble.scenario_weighting: all 12 scenarios receive equal weight; do not select the best radius or environmental cutoff from held-out outcomes

primary_reachability_quantity.name: connected_frequency
primary_reachability_quantity.definition: fraction of the 12 predeclared scenarios in which a target island is connected by any allowed island chain to at least one training-presence anchor
primary_reachability_quantity.direction: higher means structurally reachable under more declared assumptions
secondary_quantities: geography_only_connected_frequency across the four env_none scenarios
median normalized geographic bottleneck among connected scenarios

mandatory_baselines.nearest_anchor_distance: great-circle distance to the nearest training-presence island
mandatory_baselines.support_plus_distance_conditioning: primary conditional concordance strata use both pointwise support and nearest-anchor distance before reachability is compared

primary_heldout_statistic.name: species-level conditional reachability concordance
primary_heldout_statistic.fold_unit: held-out islands within one species and spatial fold

stratification.binning_rule: deterministic empirical rank bins formed from held-out pointwise support and nearest-anchor distance values without consulting held-out labels; exact ties remain in the same bin

primary_heldout_statistic.within_stratum_pairing: compare every held-out presence with every held-out absence in the same support-by-distance stratum
primary_heldout_statistic.pair_score: 1 when presence reachability > absence reachability, 0 when lower, 0.5 on a tie
primary_heldout_statistic.fold_without_comparable_pairs: explicitly unestimable; retain in applicability audit and do not replace or alter bins
primary_heldout_statistic.species_summary: unweighted mean of estimable fold concordances for that species
primary_heldout_statistic.overall_summary: unweighted mean of estimable species summaries so widespread species do not dominate by island-pair count
primary_heldout_statistic.uncertainty: 10,000 species-level bootstrap replicates with seed 20260808 plus a species-level sign-flip test of concordance minus 0.5
primary_heldout_statistic.coverage_reporting: report all 886 declared taxa, species-fold support-model applicability, reachability applicability, informative-stratum counts, comparable-pair counts and the number of species with an estimable primary statistic

secondary_outcome_metrics: held-out AUC of pointwise support alone where both classes are present
held-out AUC of connected_frequency alone where both classes are present
conditional concordance for geography-only connected frequency
conditional concordance for environmentally constrained connected frequency

claim_boundary.permitted_if_positive: Among held-out islands with similar frozen pointwise support and similar distance to known training occurrences, islands that were structurally reachable under more predeclared island-chain scenarios were more often the occupied member of a presence-absence pair.
not_permitted: the graph reconstructs the true colonisation pathway
a graph edge is a realized demographic or genetic connection
spatial block cross-validation models dispersal limitation
